veranderings.voor: Hy het nog lank daarna aanhou hoes
veranderings.na: Hy het nog lank aanhou hoes
veranderings.rede: 'daarna' doubles the following 'ook nadat' clause and repeats 'nog lank daarna' from the next paragraph; dropping it shortens the text without changing the meaning.

vlae.teks: Sy kleinboetie Neo het langs hulle op sy knieë in die sand gespeel.
vlae.rede: Coming straight after 'Anele en Marika', a Grade 4 reader can take sentence-initial 'Sy' as 'she' (Marika), and Anele is not yet known to be a boy; 'Anele se kleinboetie' would be clearer but adds a word to a text over its ceiling, so this is flagged rather than changed.
